title: Surveillance and Privacy: Stance Phrases
grammar: Recap: stance adverbials, and where they stand in a sentence
goal: I can show my attitude with a short phrase between commas (*vitán felül*, *aggasztó módon*, *érdekes módon*).
I can talk about surveillance and privacy (*algoritmusos felügyelet*, *arcfelismerő technológia*, *magánszféra védelme*).
I can say what worries me about mass data collection.
